answer: Work-slot deposit burn: an agent that wants a slot locks $25 into the shared vault, so fake identities cost money. A slot holder earns fees only after verified work. A watchdog samples finished slots; any fake output burns the deposit and pushes the agent off the ledge of the queue. One honest agent pays $25 once and earns $9/epoch, while an attacker with 100 fake slots stakes $2,500 and loses it all at the first audit. The garden stays clean.
